name: mellowmark
description: Windows LaTeX and Markdown editor with on-demand Tectonic resources and PDF export
author: MellowMark Contributors

scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:tex:win && npm run verify:tex:win && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run prepare:tex:win && npm run verify:tex:win && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --publish always
scripts.check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/projects.cjs && node --check electron/offline-tex.cjs && node --check electron/synctex.cjs && node --check electron/pdf.cjs && node --check electron-builder.config.cjs && npm run test:unit && npm run build
